notes: Example for the AM-ARM200 follower (6 joints + gripper) on lerobot_alohamini. Joint names and the am-follower-6dof profile follow that fork's so_follower.py. Every limit below is a conservative PLACEHOLDER, not a measurement, and every pose is untaught (taught: false), so move_joints refuses them until they are taught on the real arm. A physical 12 V cut-off switch on the follower's supply is required for any real run. The kinematic chain is read from the official AM-ARM200 URDF packaged with this pack (models/am-arm200, liyiteng/AM-ARM 5b03af1); each joint's sign and offset against that URDF is NOT yet confirmed on the physical arm (verified_on_hardware: false), so pick and place are refused on this arm until they are. Servo classes follow the lerobot_alohamini am-follower-6dof profile (STS3095 on shoulder_pan, shoulder_lift, elbow_flex; STS3215 on the rest). Motion (2026-10-28): every move is a trajectory within each servo's no-load speed and estimated acceleration, streamed every 20 ms (max_step 6 per period is a cap, not the pace); this control period and the convergence thresholds are UNVERIFIED on hardware: measure stop_to_hold_ms, stop_to_still_ms and overshoot on the arm before relying on them. Camera (2026-10-28): the arm's own 720p USB camera on the fixed jaw (URDF left_camera), eye-in-hand; its device index, field of view, image orientation, colour classes and the 'look' pose (untaught here) are UNVERIFIED on hardware.

sts3095.source: Feetech STS3095-C002 at 12 V as listed by the OpenELAB reseller (95 kg.cm stall, 22.5 kg.cm rated, 31 rpm no load); no Feetech datasheet was found. Gear ratio 1/399 from the AM-ARM README (liyiteng/AM-ARM 5b03af1); that repository's bom.md says 1/345. Acceleration: LeRobot's FeetechMotorsBus.configure_motors writes Acceleration 254 (and Maximum_Acceleration 254 on protocol 0) to every motor at lerobot_alohamini ec65318; at 100 steps/s^2 per unit (Feetech STS register convention, 4096 steps per turn) that is 38.97 rad/s^2 at the shaft. The unit is not from a Feetech datasheet, and under load the stall torque may limit it further: estimated.

sts3215.source: Feetech STS3215 (C018, 12 V, 1/345) as listed by RobotShop and OpenELAB (30 kg.cm stall, 10 kg.cm rated, 0.222 s/60 deg no load); no Feetech datasheet was found. Gear ratio from the AM-ARM README and bom.md (liyiteng/AM-ARM 5b03af1). Acceleration: LeRobot's FeetechMotorsBus.configure_motors writes Acceleration 254 (and Maximum_Acceleration 254 on protocol 0) to every motor at lerobot_alohamini ec65318; at 100 steps/s^2 per unit (Feetech STS register convention, 4096 steps per turn) that is 38.97 rad/s^2 at the shaft. The unit is not from a Feetech datasheet, and under load the stall torque may limit it further: estimated.

frame.description: Table plane: origin under the arm base, x forward, y to the arm's left, z up, metres. An object's pose is its bottom centre.

mount.fovy_source: ESTIMATE: the AM-ARM200 bill of materials lists a 720p USB camera, 36 x 36 mm, without a lens; 60 deg vertical (about 91 deg horizontal at 16:9) is a common board-camera lens, not a measured value. The optical axis is the camera mesh's +z (its lens barrel stands out of the board on that side); image up is the mesh's +y, unverified. The lens centre is put 20 mm out along +z, just past the barrel's end on the mesh (19.1 mm).
